description.text: A small special set for the film Detective Pikachu, released on 29 March 2019, with artwork showing the Pokémon as they look in the film. Its 18 numbered cards came in 4-card booster packs, not the usual 10, sold in special blisters and collections, and further promo cards came with events and collections.
